Nia (AE): Heads up - Asteria Labs wants a 30-day Dedicated POC. They require customer-managed keys (Thales HSM), SCCs added to the DPA, and net45 terms. Need order form signed before provisioning.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Can we get concurrency/peak? Also need to know if they want burst capacity.
Ava (Asteria): Baseline 40 qps, spikes to 150 qps. Model: rtx-6b-quantized, avg seq ~800. No key escrow, annual rotation.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Fits small Dedicated tier. KMS onboarding required: key wrap + provisioning doc, IP allowlist or VPC peering. Est provisioning: 6 business days after signed OF + keys.
Priya (Legal): For SCCs need confirmed legal entity + billing addr. "No subprocessor" is risky at enterprise scale; ask them to specify which subprocessors they want excluded.
Nia (AE): Entity: Asteria Labs, Inc. Billing addr: 12 Alder St, Dublin, IE. VAT: IE1234567. They want DocuSign with procurement + legal signers.
Kunal (Finance): Net45 ok pending PO and billing verification. If EUR invoicing, need VAT validation and remit-to details. Multiple invoices affects GL posting.
sec-bot: SECQ-9017 created and assigned to Omar + Priya. Evidence requested: Thales attestation, integration diagram, key lifecycle. Due 72h.
Priya (Legal): Ask customer to upload tracked redlines for the DPA. If not possible, send numbered redline list. We'll draft an alternative clause for subprocessor notification + objection window.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Question for Asteria: rotation frequency confirmed annual; do you require specific KMS algorithms or FIPS levels?
Ava (Asteria): FIPS 140-2 Level 3 preferred. Will include attestation language in redlines.
Nia (AE): I'll request PO + tracked redlines. Action items: (1) Asteria to send PO + DPA redlines, (2) Omar to draft capacity & KMS onboarding, (3) Priya to prepare provisional DPA response + POC SLA clause, (4) Kunal to validate VAT and payment-term exception.
Kunal (Finance): I'll prepare the payment-term exception docs and revenue ops contact.
Priya (Legal): We'll push back on blanket "no subprocessor"; propose notification + 7-day objection window.
sec-bot: SECQ-9017 updated: awaiting Thales attestation upload. Due in 48h.
Ava (Asteria): We'll upload PO + tracked redlines by Monday EOD. Also request SLA: p99 latency <=250ms for 512 tokens and 99.5% availability for POC.
Omar (Solutions Eng): We can include provisional SLA tied to Support level and credits. Will add per-route target in OF template.
Nia (AE): Thanks all. I'll post when PO + redlines arrive. :thumbsup:
